citation_heritage_view.minimal_scale: >12k (requires 22-year / 144k scale for sufficient positive citation pairs)
citation_heritage_view.evidence: Dense embeddings AUC 0.79-0.85 at 22-year scale vs TF-IDF citation-based 0.71-0.74, TF-IDF text-based 0.50-0.63. 12k subset had 0 positive pairs.

cross_lingual_view.evidence: Full-text dense cross_lang_same_branch 0.9565 at 12,570 scale. Section hierarchy: Sachverhalt (0.282) > Dispositiv (0.150) > Erwaegungen (0.094) at center_projected_64.

linear_hybrid_complement.evidence: Hybrid JP proxy >0.60 at w=0.3-0.4, but true OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Hybrids remain below TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79).
linear_hybrid_complement.product_role: Complementary mode for users wanting semantic + citation signals

data_blockers.bge_bger_id_mapping: Canonical corpus uses bge_ IDs, evaluation uses bger_ IDs — no mapping exists
